lines.text: Pokémon’s growth rates differ from species\nto species.
Silph Co. is widely known to all.\c\nIt’s a victim of its own fame. It attracted\nTeam Rocket.
*sigh*\c\nWouldn’t it be great if the Elite Four came and\nstomped out Team Rocket?
Team Rocket took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\r\nThat’s great!
There’s a book called Pokémon Journal:\nInterviews.

“In-depth coverage of the most famous guy in
Saffron City—Karate Master!\c
“Interviewer: What is the secret of your strength?\c
“Karate Master: Hwaah! Ever since I opened this
Fighting Dojo, I’ve been doing weight training
with Pokémon every single day.\c
“Look at this muscle! Look at this Pokémon!
We’re extremely well trained.\c
“Next month, a tournament will be held at the
Saffron City Gym.\c
“No matter who challenges me, I’ll defeat them
instantly with my fists!”
